kab.keineKrise: No acute crisis in the ministry
kab.disziplin.geschlossen: The government team pulls together as one.
kab.disziplin.rebellisch: Open mutiny in the cabinet: several ministers threaten to resign together.
kab.disziplin.gespalten: Deep rifts in the cabinet: turf wars are paralysing the reform course.
kab.disziplin.geordnet: Orderly government work with occasional disagreements.
kab.hh.titel: Budget course: austerity versus growth investment
kab.hh.anlass: {wer} urges budget discipline and the fight against inflation, while the line ministries demand more money.
kab.hh.sparen.text: Spending freeze for secondary ministries. Strengthens the trust of international financial markets but angers industry and the military.
kab.hh.sparen.e3: Market trust +3 pts, deficit falls by 0.6% of GDP; price: demand slows
kab.hh.sparen.m1: The president backs strict austerity in cabinet.
kab.hh.sparen.m2: Cuts to the economy budget anger industry.
kab.hh.sparen.m3: Defence budget cut in favour of the debt brake.
kab.hh.invest.text: Credit-financed money for domestic industrial projects and procurement. Boosts the economy but strains the lira and budget discipline.
kab.hh.invest.e3: Demand stimulus of 0.4% of GDP supports growth; price: deficit and debt rise. Armed forces readiness rises
kab.hh.invest.m1: Spending spree against the vote of the finance ministry.
kab.hh.invest.m2: The president approves industrial funds in cabinet.
kab.hh.ausgleich.text: No savings, but no special budgets either. Keeps the peace in cabinet but solves none of the structural problems.
kab.hh.ausgleich.e1: Cabinet mood stays stable (no notable losses)
kab.hh.ausgleich.e2: Legitimacy +1 pt through level-headed crisis management
kab.si.titel: Security doctrine: police toughness versus rule of law
kab.si.anlass: {inn} demands broader powers against protests, while {jus} warns of rebukes from the Constitutional Court.
kab.si.haerte.text: Broader powers for police and security forces. Lowers crime but deepens social division.
kab.si.haerte.m1: The president backs the security forces.
kab.si.haerte.m2: Expansion of powers ignores rule-of-law concerns.
kab.si.recht.titel: Priority for constitutional and civil rights
kab.si.recht.text: Tighten judicial oversight and have abuses investigated. Raises international standing but weakens the interior ministry.
kab.si.recht.m1: Rule-of-law guard rails defended in cabinet.
kab.si.recht.m2: The interior ministry feels abandoned by the leadership.
kab.kr.titel: Cabinet crisis: coalition peace and discipline
kab.kr.anlass: Growing discord in the cabinet threatens the ability to govern. Several ministries are working against each other.
kab.kr.machtwort.titel: Authoritarian word of power: demand discipline
kab.kr.machtwort.text: The president makes clear that troublemakers will be dismissed immediately. Brings cautious ministers into line but provokes proud figures.
kab.kr.machtwort.e2: Already rebellious ministers could break for good (-8 loyalty)
kab.kr.machtwort.e3: The signal of discipline strengthens trust in the government (+2 pts)
kab.kr.paket.titel: Ministry package: extra money to calm things down
kab.kr.paket.text: Costs 5 political capital. The president gives all ministries extra budgets to calm tempers.
kab.kr.paket.e2: Resentment of all ministers falls by -15 points
kab.kr.paket.m1: The president provides a special budget to calm the cabinet.
kab.e.kapital: Not enough political capital for that.
kab.ergebnis: The cabinet has met: “{option}” was adopted as the official government line.
